jobs.description:
Description

The Head of Flight Dynamics is the single-threaded leader responsible for orbital maneuvering, orbital safety, and orbital performance across Amazon Leo's current and future satellite constellations. This role directly impacts service reliability for millions of customers worldwide through safe, precise on-orbit operations and industry-leading space safety practices.

You will lead an organization of engineers, research scientists, and software developers building the algorithms, end-to-end ground system products, analysis tools, and infrastructure that enable safe and precise operation of Leo satellites at constellation scale. You will also lead special Flight Dynamics programs including GNSS independence, space traffic coordination services, and space situational awareness.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, operates autonomously while building alignment across organizations, and has a proven track record of delivering complex, cross-organizational technical programs that solve critical technical and business challenges. You will partner directly with engineering leaders, product managers, legal and regulatory teams, and senior Leo leadership to drive technical clarity, architect solutions, make strategic trade-offs, and deliver these enabling capabilities for Amazon Leo. You will embody Amazon's Leadership Principles — particularly Ownership, Dive Deep, Are Right A Lot, and Hire and Develop the Best.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

Own the Flight Dynamics roadmap and technical strategy, including forward-looking initiatives that enable Amazon Leo to deliver a best-in-class customer experience and leadership in orbital safety.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization of engineering managers and senior individual contributors; hire and grow top talent and foster a culture of innovation, operational excellence, and customer obsession.
Own and lead the architecture, development, and deployment of resilient ground software services and infrastructure that manage safe orbital maneuver operations of Amazon Leo satellites — ascent, station keeping, collision avoidance, and end of life descent for re-entry
Own and lead the development of algorithms for orbit determination, trajectory planning and guidance, and high-fidelity orbit modeling and prediction.
Collaborate closely with GN&C and Mission Operations to enable safe, autonomous on-orbit satellite operations that integrate seamlessly with Flight Dynamics ground systems.
Deliver the products needed by stakeholders for spacecraft design, constellation planning, and operations — including launch targets and launch-window assessments for launch and mission management teams
Provide leadership oversight and direction to the GNSS independence and space situational awareness programs.
Lead the development of metrics, monitoring, and response systems that leverage physical modeling and ML/AI to automate analysis of data from thousands of satellites for closed-loop assessment and improvement of on-orbit performance.
Initiate and lead operator-to-operator collaboration for orbital safety, and partner with regulatory and legal teams to promote adoption of best practices in space safety across the industry.
Own Flight Dynamics system risks and drive mitigations to minimize impact; manage program schedules and drive on-time delivery with support from technical program managers, balancing operational support against development efforts.
As a key voice in on-orbit operations, work with Mission Operations and peer leaders to influence efficiency, safety, performance, and simplicity for customers.

Basic Qualifications

Master's degree in engineering, physics, or equivalent
10+ years of people management, managing engineers experience
Demonstrated experience leading spacecraft flight dynamics and mission design teams, including managing both senior individual contributors and managers of teams.
Strong fundamentals in orbital mechanics, mission and trajectory design, state estimation, and orbital environments and perturbations.
Experience with orbital maneuver design and implementation using low-thrust electric propulsion systems.
Experience managing complex, large-scale satellite engineering programs and delivering products on time.
Proven ability to influence technical direction and drive consensus across multidisciplinary organizations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Highly organized, and knowledge of tools such as Jira, Confluence, Sharepoint, Git, etc.
Experience with Java, C++, or other programming language, as well as with R, MATLAB, Python, or an equivalent scripting language

Preferred Qualifications

PhD in aerospace engineering, astronautics, or a related field.
Experience with large satellite constellation operations.
Strong mathematical background with experience in numerical computation, probability, and statistics.
Knowledge of adjacent spacecraft subsystems, particularly GN&C and Propulsion.
Experience with software development workflows and engineering management.
Experience with conjunction assessment, collision avoidance workflows, and regulatory compliance (FCC/FAA)

jobs.title: Head of Infrastructure (Remote)
jobs.description:
Business Unit

Cubic Corporation

Company Details

When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.

We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.

Job Details

The Head of Infrastructure & Platforms is responsible for the operational leadership, delivery, and continuous improvement of the organization's global infrastructure and platform services.

The role manages multiple technical disciplines, including cloud infrastructure, enterprise networking, identity services, endpoint management, server and hosting platforms, and related infrastructure operations. The postholder ensures that these services are secure, reliable, supportable, and delivered in accordance with approved business, financial, security, and compliance requirements.

Working within the direction set by senior IT leadership, the role establishes departmental objectives, operating procedures, work plans, and priorities; manages the department budget; allocates resources; and delegates assignments across experienced technical professionals and, where applicable, subordinate managers.

The successful candidate will combine effective people leadership with broad technical knowledge and sound tactical decision-making. The role is expected to resolve complex operational issues, deliver larger infrastructure projects, and translate approved technology plans into practical, measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Departmental Leadership & Operational Planning

Establish departmental objectives, operating procedures, work plans, delivery priorities, and performance expectations in line with approved IT strategy and organizational policies.
Translate approved infrastructure roadmaps into operational plans, resource assignments, schedules, and measurable departmental outcomes.
Make implementation decisions within delegated authority and escalate matters that require broader functional or enterprise direction.
Provide recommendations to senior IT leadership regarding infrastructure architecture, operational risk, service improvement, and technology investment.

Infrastructure & Platform Service Delivery

Manage the reliable and secure delivery of enterprise networking, cloud infrastructure, data center and hosting services, identity platforms, endpoint management, collaboration infrastructure, and server services.
Coordinate the work of multiple infrastructure disciplines and ensure clear ownership, effective handoffs, and consistent operating practices.
Monitor service availability, capacity, performance, supportability, technical debt, and lifecycle risk, implementing corrective plans where required.
Establish and review departmental KPIs, SLAs, operational health measures, and service improvement actions.

Cloud & Platform Implementation

Manage delivery of cloud infrastructure services across Azure, AWS, and related hosting environments in accordance with approved architecture and governance standards.
Plan and deliver approved cloud migrations, platform upgrades, infrastructure rationalization, and legacy hosting reduction activities.
Ensure cloud and hosting environments meet defined requirements for resilience, security, cost, supportability, documentation, and operational readiness.
Work with application owners, architects, Security, and service providers to sequence and deliver migration and modernization plans.

Network Architecture & Engineering Oversight

Manage enterprise network services and provide technical direction across SD-WAN, routing and switching, firewalls, network segmentation, VLAN and VRF design, internet and WAN connectivity, and hybrid cloud networking.
Oversee network workstreams for site openings, relocations, consolidations, lab environments, and business segmentation initiatives.
Review technical designs and implementation plans to confirm alignment with approved standards, security controls, operational support requirements, and change processes.
Advise technical teams on moderately complex network and infrastructure matters and coordinate resolution of issues that span disciplines.

Endpoint, Identity & Security Platforms

Manage infrastructure delivery and operational support for endpoint management, device compliance, identity services, privileged access controls, endpoint security platforms, and infrastructure hardening standards.
Deliver approved transitions and improvements involving Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure Arc, and related endpoint and identity services.
Coordinate implementation with Information Security, Service Desk, regional IT, and technical suppliers.
Ensure controls and operational procedures are applied consistently, documented, monitored, and remediated where gaps are identified.

Compliance, Resilience & Risk

Implement infrastructure controls and remediation plans required to support CMMC, NIST-based controls, ISO standards, government or defense requirements, and internal audit activities.
Manage departmental activities relating to network segmentation, access governance, asset and configuration records, infrastructure baselines, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Maintain evidence and documentation required to demonstrate that assigned infrastructure controls are operating as intended.
Identify departmental risks, assess operational impact, define corrective actions, and report significant risks to senior IT leadership.

IT Service Management & Change Governance

Ensure infrastructure teams comply with established Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, Configuration, Request, and Access Management processes.
Represent Infrastructure in CAB, problem review, major incident, service review, and operational governance forums.
Oversee pilot planning, implementation sequencing, risk and impact assessment, business and Service Desk communications, rollback planning, and post-implementation review for major infrastructure changes.
Improve departmental procedures and supporting ServiceNow workflows within delegated process ownership and governance.

Budget, Suppliers & Cost Management

Prepare, manage, and monitor the departmental infrastructure budget in accordance with approved financial plans and delegated authority.
Manage day-to-day relationships and performance across managed service providers, cloud providers, network carriers, hosting providers, security vendors, and technology partners.
Support sourcing, contract renewal, service review, and purchasing decisions by providing technical requirements, usage data, risk assessments, and recommendations.
Identify and implement approved opportunities to consolidate services, reduce unnecessary cost, improve licensing efficiency, and optimize infrastructure consumption.

People Leadership & Global Ways of Working

Manage and develop experienced infrastructure professionals across multiple disciplines and regions and, where applicable, oversee subordinate managers or team leads.
Delegate assignments, establish accountability, review delivery, coach team members, and address capability or performance gaps through established management processes.
Build effective operational collaboration across regional and offshore teams, supporting consistent standards and follow-the-sun delivery.
Maintain departmental succession plans, skills development priorities, architecture documentation, standards, runbooks, diagrams, and knowledge-sharing practices.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Work regularly with senior management, Security, Architecture, application teams, business stakeholders, suppliers, and customers on infrastructure matters affecting several operational areas.
Present analysis, delivery options, risks, cost implications, and recommendations to support departmental decisions.
Influence stakeholders in sensitive or complex situations while preserving productive working relationships and maintaining focus on approved outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
A minimum of 12 years of relevant infrastructure experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 8 years with a Master's degree, or equivalent experience.
Significant experience managing a department or multiple infrastructure disciplines, including experienced technical professionals and/or subordinate managers.
Demonstrated experience delivering complex infrastructure projects and operational improvements within approved strategy, budget, and governance.
Broad technical knowledge across enterprise networking, cloud platforms, identity services, endpoint management, infrastructure security, server platforms, and IT operations.
Experience managing departmental budgets, suppliers, contracts, service performance, and cost optimization activities.
Working knowledge of ITSM processes and platforms, including Change, Incident, Problem, Asset, Configuration, Request, and Access Management.
Strong written, verbal, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and recommendations to senior management.
Ability to obtain and maintain security clearance if required.

Present analysis, delivery options, risks, cost implications, and recommendations to support departmental decisions.

Senior Director, Flights Engineering

Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you’re in the right place.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As one of our leaders, you’ll have a big impact on our products and their technical direction, as well as influence the company's technical strategy. You will also have a big impact on your team members, their day-to-day experience on our team and their growth over time. To continuously deliver on our goal to be the best travel deal makers in the world for millions of our customers, we need to have well designed technology that is reliable, performs well, and allows for the continuous improvements we make to our products, and we also need to have teams that feel engaged, productive, empowered, and sustainable. All of this requires talented leaders with the right mix of technical, collaborative, management, and leadership skills and values.

In This Role You Will Get To

Lead and be responsible for a software development teams that owns the services that power Priceline’s Flight Shopping Platform
Serve as a leader of leaders, scaling delivery and cross-functional execution through your teams
Drive technology strategy, operational backbone, and system architecture decisions across the flights domain
Lead adoption of AI/agentic engineering practices to accelerate shopping-experience innovation
Own the multi-team roadmap and partner with Product Group Engineering leads, flight commercial stakeholders, and cross-functional peers to set priorities and long-term technical direction
Manage and coach talented managers and engineers of all levels of experience.
Have influence on what we build, how we build, and how we work.
Participate in various formal and/or grass-roots technical and non-technical communities at Priceline.
Become part of a team and organization that is passionate about our work, but values a healthy work/life balance.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or related field.
15+ years of experience in software engineering and development.
5+ years experience in leading software development teams.
Proven track record managing a mix of people-managers and senior ICs, overseeing an org of 20+ across multiple teams
B2C, e-commerce, or OTA experience, ideally with a strong experimentation culture; travel industry experience a plus
Skilled at hiring, coaching, and developing engineering leaders, including performance management of managers
Experience operating across global, cross-functional teams and managing competing priorities through organizational change
Proven collaboration skills with both technical and less-technical colleagues.
Experience with developing on Cloud, especially GCP and AWS.
Strong system-architecture fluency, with comfort partnering deeply on technical decisions
Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $210,000- $265,000K USD.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage
including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off
including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support
including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs
such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks
including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts
like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture
with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Credit Cards
jobs.description:
In 1968, the New York Stock Exchange began closing on Wednesdays so brokerage firms could catch up on paperwork. Every transaction depended on physical stock certificates being delivered, recorded, and reconciled. Trading had outgrown the infrastructure behind it. The expression “Paperwork crisis” had entered the nation's agenda resulting in other temporary measures like shortened trading days and extending settlement. The industry responded with electronic clearing systems and the establishment of the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) laying the foundation for markets that could operate at an entirely different scale.

Every share needs an identity, every movement needs a record, and every balance needs to agree with the institutions holding the assets. The best financial infrastructure makes this complexity feel ordinary. Building it takes extraordinary care.

At Mercury, our Investments team helps founders put their capital to work through products like Treasury and Invest. Our Custody team builds the systems underneath that experience: the ledger, security master service, reconciliation, and operational tools that keep customer assets accurately accounted for and give our products a dependable foundation to grow.

We’re looking for a senior engineering manager to lead the Custody team through its next stages of growth and scale to better serve our small and large customers.

As part of this role, you will:

Lead, hire, and develop a team of senior engineers, providing thoughtful feedback and building a trusting and supportive environment.
Own the team’s technical strategy and roadmap, translating Mercury’s investment ambitions into focused priorities and predictable delivery.
Guide the design and evolution of core custody systems, including cash and securities ledgers, security master service, position tracking, and reconciliation.
Partner with product, investment operations, and compliance to turn business and regulatory requirements into well-designed systems, operational controls, and auditable workflows that balance correctness, scale, and maintainability.
Collaborate with Product and Partnerships to align integrations, responsibilities, and technical roadmaps.
Set a high bar for correctness, reliability, and incident response, balancing new capabilities with the maintenance and improvement of critical systems.

The ideal candidate for the role:

Has 3+ years of experience managing highly technical teams.
Has direct experience building or operating RIA and broker-dealer custody systems at scale, including ledgers, security master service, cash and securities reconciliation, and money movement.
Understands the broker-dealer operating model and how responsibilities and data flow across introducing brokers, clearing firms, and custodians.
Has worked closely with compliance and operations teams, translating requirements into practical engineering decisions and effective controls.
Understands the lifecycle of securities and the implications of settlement and corporate actions for customer cash and positions across equities, fixed income, ETFs, and mutual funds.

Technology, Data, AI And Ventures:

Within the Tech, Data, AI, Ventures (TDAV) organization, our work is guided by a shared vision: deploying the power of technology, data, AI and ventures to accelerate sustainable competitive advantage for New York Life's businesses. We build solutions that power how we serve policy owners, agents, advisors and employees while delivering measurable business outcomes.

Across technology, data, AI, cyber, product, digital experience, architecture and infrastructure, TDAV combines the scale and investment of an industry leader, access to leading-edge technologies and the opportunity to help shape how a world-class financial services company competes in the AI era - all backed by the stability and purpose of a mutual company built to last.

Business Overview

Enterprise Plan to Perform (EPP) is one of New York Life's strategic transformations, focused on reimagining how the enterprise plans, projects, understands, and manages financial performance. EPP spans Expense Management, Planning & Projections, Performance Management, Financial Modeling, NEXUS, and related enterprise capabilities, bringing together business-process reimagination, modern technology, data, analytics, automation, and AI.

Role Overview

The Corporate Vice President, NEXUS Technology provides senior technology leadership for a major domain within New York Life's Enterprise Plan to Perform (EPP) transformation. The initial assignment is NEXUS, the common cross-EPP experience and technology embodiment of EPP. The leader will own the end-to-end technology strategy and delivery of NEXUS, integrating capabilities from Performance, Planning & Projections, Expense, Financial Modeling, data, analytics, and AI into a coherent decision experience.

The role owns the end-to-end technology capability for the domain, spanning technology strategy, roadmap, applications, data and analytics requirements, AI and automation, architecture, integration, engineering, controls, production readiness, workforce and partner capacity, and measurable business outcomes. The leader works across Finance, business, Technology, Data, Architecture, Risk and Control functions, and strategic partners to translate future-state business intent into scalable enterprise capabilities.

This is broader than an application development or program management role. The leader is expected to combine business understanding, systems thinking, technology and engineering judgment, and transformation leadership; challenge current-state constraints; and ensure the domain evolves as a coherent capability that integrates effectively with the broader EPP ecosystem and NEXUS experience.

Domain Technology Strategy & Ownership

Own the end-to-end NEXUS technology strategy, roadmap, engineering, and delivery across application experience, orchestration, integration, analytics, AI, and agentic capabilities.
Ensure NEXUS evolves beyond a dashboard or presentation layer into an intelligent decision-support experience that proactively surfaces insights, explains drivers, supports exploration and scenarios, and enables action.
Lead NEXUS outcome teams spanning executive and practitioner experiences, conversational and agentic interaction, proactive insights, cross-domain workflows, and reusable experience capabilities.
Integrate deterministic metrics and analytics with agentic retrieval, reasoning, explanation, and workflow orchestration using appropriate enterprise controls and traceability.
Establish persona-aware experiences that provide appropriate depth and interaction for executives, Finance leaders, FP&A practitioners, and business users without fragmenting the underlying product.
Own the technical integration of capabilities supplied by Expense, Planning & Projections, Performance Technology, Financial Modeling, and shared enterprise services.

Technology, AI & Engineering Leadership

Own the target-state technology strategy and roadmap for the domain, including application, integration, data, analytics, AI, automation, and engineering implications.
Drive pragmatic use of rapid prototyping, specification-driven development, AI-assisted engineering, automated testing, and continuous business validation.
Promote systems thinking so solution decisions account for upstream and downstream impacts across workflows, data, architecture, security, controls, and operations.
Identify where generative AI and agentic capabilities can materially reimagine workflows, analysis, decision support, and execution rather than simply automate existing steps.
Maintain strong standards for engineering quality, scalability, resiliency, responsible AI, observability, production readiness, and technical sustainability.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Interfaces

Partner with Performance Technology, which owns the underlying Performance Management capability, data/analytics requirements, and performance technology outcomes; NEXUS owns how those capabilities are integrated into the common experience.
Partner with each EPP Domain Technology Lead to integrate domain capabilities without duplicating domain ownership.
Partner with Solution Engineering & Architecture on application, agent, integration, and reusable engineering patterns and with Data Architecture on semantics, data products, provenance, and deterministic versus agentic access patterns.
Partner with Business Discovery & Solution Strategy leaders to translate future-state business intent into executable technology capabilities and roadmaps.
Partner with Solution Engineering & Architecture and Data Architecture to ensure domain solutions align with cross-EPP architecture and data patterns.
Lead multidisciplinary outcome teams and coordinate NYL engineers, forward deployed engineers, federated resources, domain SMEs, and strategic partner engineers.
Build trusted relationships with senior Finance, business, and Technology stakeholders and create transparency around priorities, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and outcomes.

Shape domain investment priorities, sequencing, resource requirements, and capacity plans based on business value, dependencies, risk, and delivery readiness.
Manage strategic technology and engineering partners as an integrated part of the domain team with clear accountability for quality, outcomes, and knowledge transfer.
Establish transparent measures of delivery health, adoption, quality, and value realization and use them to drive decisions and accountability.
Ensure security, privacy, controls, auditability, and operational readiness are incorporated from inception through production.

Talent & Organizational Leadership

Build, lead and develop high performing teams with strong domain knowledge and modern technology and engineering capabilities.
Attract, develop and retain forward deployed and other high caliber technology talent, while building technology leadership and domain expertise across the organization.
Establish clear accountability and a culture of collaboration, innovation, engineering discipline and continuous improvement.
Lead effectively through both direct authority and matrixed relationships across Business, Product, Technology and partner teams.

What You'll Bring

Required Experience

15+ years of progressively responsible experience in technology, software engineering, solution delivery, digital transformation, or related disciplines, including significant leadership responsibility in complex enterprise environments.
Proven experience owning end-to-end technology capabilities or major transformation domains from strategy through architecture, engineering, implementation, and measurable outcomes.
Demonstrated success operating in federated or matrixed enterprises and influencing senior business and technology stakeholders across organizational boundaries.
Broad technology and engineering background spanning modern application development, APIs and integration, data and analytics, cloud platforms, enterprise architecture, automation, and emerging technologies.
Strong understanding of generative AI, agentic technologies, and AI-assisted engineering and their practical application to enterprise workflows and software delivery.
Experience leading multidisciplinary technology teams and managing strategic partners, contractors, and federated resources.
Experience operating within enterprise Risk, Security, Compliance, Audit, and control environments.
Strong analytical, communication, prioritization, and executive-influence capabilities.

Description

The Head of Flight Dynamics is the single-threaded leader responsible for orbital maneuvering, orbital safety, and orbital performance across Amazon Leo's current and future satellite constellations. This role directly impacts service reliability for millions of customers worldwide through safe, precise on-orbit operations and industry-leading space safety practices.

You will lead an organization of engineers, research scientists, and software developers building the algorithms, end-to-end ground system products, analysis tools, and infrastructure that enable safe and precise operation of Leo satellites at constellation scale. You will also lead special Flight Dynamics programs including GNSS independence, space traffic coordination services, and space situational awareness.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, operates autonomously while building alignment across organizations, and has a proven track record of delivering complex, cross-organizational technical programs that solve critical technical and business challenges. You will partner directly with engineering leaders, product managers, legal and regulatory teams, and senior Leo leadership to drive technical clarity, architect solutions, make strategic trade-offs, and deliver these enabling capabilities for Amazon Leo. You will embody Amazon's Leadership Principles — particularly Ownership, Dive Deep, Are Right A Lot, and Hire and Develop the Best.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

Own the Flight Dynamics roadmap and technical strategy, including forward-looking initiatives that enable Amazon Leo to deliver a best-in-class customer experience and leadership in orbital safety.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing organization of engineering managers and senior individual contributors; hire and grow top talent and foster a culture of innovation, operational excellence, and customer obsession.
Own and lead the architecture, development, and deployment of resilient ground software services and infrastructure that manage safe orbital maneuver operations of Amazon Leo satellites — ascent, station keeping, collision avoidance, and end of life descent for re-entry
Own and lead the development of algorithms for orbit determination, trajectory planning and guidance, and high-fidelity orbit modeling and prediction.
Collaborate closely with GN&C and Mission Operations to enable safe, autonomous on-orbit satellite operations that integrate seamlessly with Flight Dynamics ground systems.
Deliver the products needed by stakeholders for spacecraft design, constellation planning, and operations — including launch targets and launch-window assessments for launch and mission management teams
Provide leadership oversight and direction to the GNSS independence and space situational awareness programs.
Lead the development of metrics, monitoring, and response systems that leverage physical modeling and ML/AI to automate analysis of data from thousands of satellites for closed-loop assessment and improvement of on-orbit performance.
Initiate and lead operator-to-operator collaboration for orbital safety, and partner with regulatory and legal teams to promote adoption of best practices in space safety across the industry.
Own Flight Dynamics system risks and drive mitigations to minimize impact; manage program schedules and drive on-time delivery with support from technical program managers, balancing operational support against development efforts.
As a key voice in on-orbit operations, work with Mission Operations and peer leaders to influence efficiency, safety, performance, and simplicity for customers.

Master's degree in engineering, physics, or equivalent
10+ years of people management, managing engineers experience

Strong fundamentals in orbital mechanics, mission and trajectory design, state estimation, and orbital environments and perturbations.
Experience with orbital maneuver design and implementation using low-thrust electric propulsion systems.
Experience managing complex, large-scale satellite engineering programs and delivering products on time.
Proven ability to influence technical direction and drive consensus across multidisciplinary organizations.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Highly organized, and knowledge of tools such as Jira, Confluence, Sharepoint, Git, etc.
Experience with Java, C++, or other programming language, as well as with R, MATLAB, Python, or an equivalent scripting language

Preferred Qualifications

PhD in aerospace engineering, astronautics, or a related field.
Experience with large satellite constellation operations.
Strong mathematical background with experience in numerical computation, probability, and statistics.
Knowledge of adjacent spacecraft subsystems, particularly GN&C and Propulsion.
Experience with software development workflows and engineering management.
Experience with conjunction assessment, collision avoidance workflows, and regulatory compliance (FCC/FAA)

Job Details

The Head of Infrastructure & Platforms is responsible for the operational leadership, delivery, and continuous improvement of the organization's global infrastructure and platform services.

The role manages multiple technical disciplines, including cloud infrastructure, enterprise networking, identity services, endpoint management, server and hosting platforms, and related infrastructure operations. The postholder ensures that these services are secure, reliable, supportable, and delivered in accordance with approved business, financial, security, and compliance requirements.

Working within the direction set by senior IT leadership, the role establishes departmental objectives, operating procedures, work plans, and priorities; manages the department budget; allocates resources; and delegates assignments across experienced technical professionals and, where applicable, subordinate managers.

The successful candidate will combine effective people leadership with broad technical knowledge and sound tactical decision-making. The role is expected to resolve complex operational issues, deliver larger infrastructure projects, and translate approved technology plans into practical, measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Departmental Leadership & Operational Planning

Establish departmental objectives, operating procedures, work plans, delivery priorities, and performance expectations in line with approved IT strategy and organizational policies.
Translate approved infrastructure roadmaps into operational plans, resource assignments, schedules, and measurable departmental outcomes.
Make implementation decisions within delegated authority and escalate matters that require broader functional or enterprise direction.
Provide recommendations to senior IT leadership regarding infrastructure architecture, operational risk, service improvement, and technology investment.

Infrastructure & Platform Service Delivery

Manage the reliable and secure delivery of enterprise networking, cloud infrastructure, data center and hosting services, identity platforms, endpoint management, collaboration infrastructure, and server services.
Coordinate the work of multiple infrastructure disciplines and ensure clear ownership, effective handoffs, and consistent operating practices.
Monitor service availability, capacity, performance, supportability, technical debt, and lifecycle risk, implementing corrective plans where required.
Establish and review departmental KPIs, SLAs, operational health measures, and service improvement actions.

Cloud & Platform Implementation

Manage delivery of cloud infrastructure services across Azure, AWS, and related hosting environments in accordance with approved architecture and governance standards.
Plan and deliver approved cloud migrations, platform upgrades, infrastructure rationalization, and legacy hosting reduction activities.
Ensure cloud and hosting environments meet defined requirements for resilience, security, cost, supportability, documentation, and operational readiness.
Work with application owners, architects, Security, and service providers to sequence and deliver migration and modernization plans.

Network Architecture & Engineering Oversight

Manage enterprise network services and provide technical direction across SD-WAN, routing and switching, firewalls, network segmentation, VLAN and VRF design, internet and WAN connectivity, and hybrid cloud networking.
Oversee network workstreams for site openings, relocations, consolidations, lab environments, and business segmentation initiatives.
Review technical designs and implementation plans to confirm alignment with approved standards, security controls, operational support requirements, and change processes.
Advise technical teams on moderately complex network and infrastructure matters and coordinate resolution of issues that span disciplines.

Endpoint, Identity & Security Platforms

Manage infrastructure delivery and operational support for endpoint management, device compliance, identity services, privileged access controls, endpoint security platforms, and infrastructure hardening standards.
Deliver approved transitions and improvements involving Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, Entra ID, Active Directory, Azure Arc, and related endpoint and identity services.
Coordinate implementation with Information Security, Service Desk, regional IT, and technical suppliers.
Ensure controls and operational procedures are applied consistently, documented, monitored, and remediated where gaps are identified.

Compliance, Resilience & Risk

Implement infrastructure controls and remediation plans required to support CMMC, NIST-based controls, ISO standards, government or defense requirements, and internal audit activities.
Manage departmental activities relating to network segmentation, access governance, asset and configuration records, infrastructure baselines, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Maintain evidence and documentation required to demonstrate that assigned infrastructure controls are operating as intended.
Identify departmental risks, assess operational impact, define corrective actions, and report significant risks to senior IT leadership.

IT Service Management & Change Governance

Ensure infrastructure teams comply with established Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, Configuration, Request, and Access Management processes.
Represent Infrastructure in CAB, problem review, major incident, service review, and operational governance forums.
Oversee pilot planning, implementation sequencing, risk and impact assessment, business and Service Desk communications, rollback planning, and post-implementation review for major infrastructure changes.
Improve departmental procedures and supporting ServiceNow workflows within delegated process ownership and governance.

Budget, Suppliers & Cost Management

Prepare, manage, and monitor the departmental infrastructure budget in accordance with approved financial plans and delegated authority.
Manage day-to-day relationships and performance across managed service providers, cloud providers, network carriers, hosting providers, security vendors, and technology partners.
Support sourcing, contract renewal, service review, and purchasing decisions by providing technical requirements, usage data, risk assessments, and recommendations.
Identify and implement approved opportunities to consolidate services, reduce unnecessary cost, improve licensing efficiency, and optimize infrastructure consumption.

People Leadership & Global Ways of Working

Manage and develop experienced infrastructure professionals across multiple disciplines and regions and, where applicable, oversee subordinate managers or team leads.
Delegate assignments, establish accountability, review delivery, coach team members, and address capability or performance gaps through established management processes.
Build effective operational collaboration across regional and offshore teams, supporting consistent standards and follow-the-sun delivery.
Maintain departmental succession plans, skills development priorities, architecture documentation, standards, runbooks, diagrams, and knowledge-sharing practices.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Work regularly with senior management, Security, Architecture, application teams, business stakeholders, suppliers, and customers on infrastructure matters affecting several operational areas.
Present analysis, delivery options, risks, cost implications, and recommendations to support departmental decisions.
Influence stakeholders in sensitive or complex situations while preserving productive working relationships and maintaining focus on approved outcomes.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
A minimum of 12 years of relevant infrastructure experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 8 years with a Master's degree, or equivalent experience.
Significant experience managing a department or multiple infrastructure disciplines, including experienced technical professionals and/or subordinate managers.
Demonstrated experience delivering complex infrastructure projects and operational improvements within approved strategy, budget, and governance.
Broad technical knowledge across enterprise networking, cloud platforms, identity services, endpoint management, infrastructure security, server platforms, and IT operations.
Experience managing departmental budgets, suppliers, contracts, service performance, and cost optimization activities.
Working knowledge of ITSM processes and platforms, including Change, Incident, Problem, Asset, Configuration, Request, and Access Management.
Strong written, verbal, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and recommendations to senior management.
Ability to obtain and maintain security clearance if required.

Senior Director, Flights Engineering

Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you’re in the right place.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As one of our leaders, you’ll have a big impact on our products and their technical direction, as well as influence the company's technical strategy. You will also have a big impact on your team members, their day-to-day experience on our team and their growth over time. To continuously deliver on our goal to be the best travel deal makers in the world for millions of our customers, we need to have well designed technology that is reliable, performs well, and allows for the continuous improvements we make to our products, and we also need to have teams that feel engaged, productive, empowered, and sustainable. All of this requires talented leaders with the right mix of technical, collaborative, management, and leadership skills and values.

In This Role You Will Get To

Lead and be responsible for a software development teams that owns the services that power Priceline’s Flight Shopping Platform
Serve as a leader of leaders, scaling delivery and cross-functional execution through your teams
Drive technology strategy, operational backbone, and system architecture decisions across the flights domain
Lead adoption of AI/agentic engineering practices to accelerate shopping-experience innovation
Own the multi-team roadmap and partner with Product Group Engineering leads, flight commercial stakeholders, and cross-functional peers to set priorities and long-term technical direction
Manage and coach talented managers and engineers of all levels of experience.
Have influence on what we build, how we build, and how we work.
Participate in various formal and/or grass-roots technical and non-technical communities at Priceline.
Become part of a team and organization that is passionate about our work, but values a healthy work/life balance.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or related field.
15+ years of experience in software engineering and development.
5+ years experience in leading software development teams.
Proven track record managing a mix of people-managers and senior ICs, overseeing an org of 20+ across multiple teams
B2C, e-commerce, or OTA experience, ideally with a strong experimentation culture; travel industry experience a plus
Skilled at hiring, coaching, and developing engineering leaders, including performance management of managers
Experience operating across global, cross-functional teams and managing competing priorities through organizational change
Proven collaboration skills with both technical and less-technical colleagues.
Experience with developing on Cloud, especially GCP and AWS.
Strong system-architecture fluency, with comfort partnering deeply on technical decisions
Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $210,000- $265,000K USD.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage
including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off
including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support
including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs
such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks
including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts
like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture
with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

In 1968, the New York Stock Exchange began closing on Wednesdays so brokerage firms could catch up on paperwork. We’re looking for a senior engineering manager to lead the Custody team through its next stages of growth and scale to better serve our small and large customers.

Lead, hire, and develop a team of senior engineers, providing thoughtful feedback and building a trusting and supportive environment.
Own the team’s technical strategy and roadmap, translating Mercury’s investment ambitions into focused priorities and predictable delivery.
Guide the design and evolution of core custody systems, including cash and securities ledgers, security master service, position tracking, and reconciliation.
Partner with product, investment operations, and compliance to turn business and regulatory requirements into well-designed systems, operational controls, and auditable workflows that balance correctness, scale, and maintainability.
Collaborate with Product and Partnerships to align integrations, responsibilities, and technical roadmaps.
Set a high bar for correctness, reliability, and incident response, balancing new capabilities with the maintenance and improvement of critical systems.

Has 3+ years of experience managing highly technical teams.
Has direct experience building or operating RIA and broker-dealer custody systems at scale, including ledgers, security master service, cash and securities reconciliation, and money movement.
